# Test data sources

## `snapshots/input/**`

Written for this project (no third-party code): `iso/` (ISO 7185 program), `turbo/` (Turbo Pascal unit with
`object` types, include file, program), `lazarus/` (Free Pascal objfpc unit, Lazarus program/form/project).
Expected snapshots in `snapshots/output/**` are generated by the indexer; regenerate with
`SCIP_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 dotnet test --project tests/ScipSharp.Indexer.Pascal.Tests` and review the diff.

## `corpus/pascal-p5/` — robustness corpus (ISO 7185)

- Origin: https://github.com/samiam95124/Pascal-P5 at commit `f730c1c03de861dfcf1a88c7b320268c3a456bcc`
- Files: `source/pcom.pas`, `source/pint.pas`, `source/mpb16.inc`, `source/mpb32.inc`, `source/mpb64.inc`,
  `sample_programs/{basics,pascals,startrek,qsort,roman,prime}.pas` (copied verbatim).
- Licence: public domain (Pascal-P4 heritage, Niklaus Wirth / ETH Zurich) plus BSD-2-Clause for the Pascal-P5
  changes (Copyright (c) 2020 Scott A. Franco); full text in `corpus/pascal-p5/LICENSE.txt`.
